text:
morgan_ae: Procurement says they can wire today to speed POC close. Legal prefers DocuSign. Can we accept wire-first with controls?

maria_legal: We can accept wire only with controls: (1) countersigned MSA/Order Form OR (2) PO with tax ID, explicit wiring_authorization, and exec approval for >$250k. Otherwise propose DocuSign.

ed_fin: Finance can accept a 10% holdback on a wire if buyer provides exec email and PO mappings. Escrow is slower. Need PO fields: po_number, amount, currency, tax_id, bill_to, wiring_authorization.

sam_se: We'll provide KMS attestation and SecQ answers today. Note: customer-managed HSM onboarding is 2-3w and requires contract confirmation; wiring before countersign may delay HSM.

upload-bot: Uploaded: orderform_quickfill_v2.pdf and msa_dpa_redline_short.docx to drive: https://redwood.co/drive/quick (perms: sales,legal,finance).

maria_legal: I'll add a short PO/wire FAQ and propose SLA language: credits up to 25% monthly, per-incident cap 10%, measured by Redwood telemetry. Recommend we stick to that.

morgan_ae: I'll push procurement to DocuSign and offer the 10% holdback as fallback. Tagging @maria_legal and @sam_se for docs and attestation. :thumbsup:
